#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

long long power(long long x, long long y, long long mod) {
    long long ans = 1;
    while (y > 0) {
        if (y % 2 == 1)
            ans = (ans * x) % mod;
        x = (x * x) % mod;
        y /= 2;
    }
    return ans;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    const long long num = 998244353;
    long long n, k;
    cin >> n >> k;

    vector<long long> fact(200001);
    fact[0] = 1;
    long long ans1 = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= 200000; i++) {
        ans1 = (ans1 * i) % num;
        fact[i] = ans1;
    }

    long long ans = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n - k; i++) {
        long long ks = 1;
        ks = (ks * fact[n - k]) % num;
        ks = (ks * power(fact[i], num - 2, num)) % num;
        ks = (ks * power(fact[n - k - i], num - 2, num)) % num;
        if (i % 2 == 0) {
            ans = (ans + ks * power(n - k - i, n, num)) % num;
        } else {
            ans = (ans - ks * power(n - k - i, n, num)) % num;
        }
    }
    ans = (ans + num) % num; // ensure non-negative

    if (k >= n) {
        cout << 0 << "\n";
    } else {
        if (k != 0)
            ans = (ans * 2) % num;
        ans = (ans * fact[n]) % num;
        ans = (ans * power(fact[k], num - 2, num)) % num;
        ans = (ans * power(fact[n - k], num - 2, num)) % num;
        cout << ans % num << "\n";
    }
    return 0;
}
